blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 User Requirement Specification (URS) 的標準架構，並能識別製程氣體系統中的關鍵需求項目
blocks.en: Understand the standard structure of a User Requirement Specification (URS) and identify the key requirement items for a process gas system

blocks.zh: 掌握系統洩漏對氣體純度的影響機制，以及壓力測試與洩漏偵測在 IQ 中的角色
blocks.en: Understand how system leakage affects gas purity, and the role of pressure testing and leak detection in IQ

blocks.zh: 比較三種現場氮氣產生技術（膜分離、PSA 吸附、低溫液化）的純度範圍與適用場景
blocks.en: Compare the three on-site nitrogen generation technologies (membrane separation, PSA adsorption, cryogenic liquefaction) in terms of purity range and suitable applications

blocks.zh: 熟悉本指引引用的核心標準（ISO 8573-1、USP、PhEur、ICH Q9）及其在氣體系統資格確認中的定位
blocks.en: Become familiar with the core standards cited in this guide (ISO 8573-1, USP, PhEur, ICH Q9) and their place in gas system qualification

blocks.zh: 能使用術語表（Glossary）快速查找氣體系統資格確認計畫中的關鍵縮寫與定義
blocks.en: Use the Glossary to quickly look up key abbreviations and definitions in a gas system qualification program

blocks.zh: Appendix 4 — Sample User Requirement Specifications (URS) 使用者需求規格書範例
blocks.en: Appendix 4 - Sample User Requirement Specifications (URS)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — URS 是什麼？
blocks.en: Core Concept - What Is a URS?

blocks.zh: User Requirement Specification (URS, 使用者需求規格書) 是整個資格確認（Qualification）生命週期的起點文件。它用業務語言描述「系統必須做到什麼」，而不涉及如何設計或製造。
blocks.en: The User Requirement Specification (URS) is the starting document of the entire qualification lifecycle. It describes in business language what the system must do, without addressing how it is designed or built.

blocks.zh: URS 的重要性在於：它直接連結到 DQ（設計資格）、IQ（安裝資格）、OQ（運行資格）的驗收標準。沒有明確的 URS，後續的 IQ/OQ 測試就失去了判斷基準。
blocks.en: The URS matters because it links directly to the acceptance criteria of DQ (design qualification), IQ (installation qualification) and OQ (operational qualification). Without a clear URS, the subsequent IQ/OQ tests have no basis for judgment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 15 個 URS 項目的分類策略
blocks.en: Key Point - Classification Strategy for the 15 URS Items

blocks.zh: 這15個需求項目中，哪些是 CQA（關鍵品質屬性），哪些是 CPP（關鍵製程參數），哪些只是商業需求？這個分類決定了資格確認的深度：
blocks.en: Among these 15 requirement items, which are CQAs (critical quality attributes), which are CPPs (critical process parameters), and which are merely business requirements? This classification determines the depth of qualification:

blocks.zh: CQA 等級（1–6）：純度、水分、顆粒、微生物限度、壓力、流量 — 直接影響產品品質，需完整 IQ/OQ/PQ
blocks.en: CQA level (items 1-6): purity, moisture, particles, microbial limits, pressure, flow - these directly affect product quality and require full IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: 商業需求（7–15）：操作時間、維護、警報、供應商選擇 — 影響營運，但不直接影響產品品質
blocks.en: Business requirements (items 7-15): operating hours, maintenance, alarms, supplier selection - these affect operations but not product quality directly

blocks.zh: 規格確認時，只有 CQA/CPP 相關的項目才需要包含在 PQ 測試計畫中。
blocks.en: When confirming the specification, only CQA/CPP-related items need to be included in the PQ test plan.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — URS 就像建築許可前的需求書
blocks.en: Analogy - The URS Is Like the Owner's Brief Before a Building Permit

blocks.zh: 建築師開始畫圖之前，業主必須先說清楚：需要幾層樓、要容納多少人、有沒有殘障設施需求。URS 就是這份「業主需求書」。工程師後來設計的圖面（DS）、安裝的結果（IQ）、測試的運行（OQ）都必須回溯到這份需求書來確認是否符合。
blocks.en: Before the architect starts drawing, the owner must state clearly how many floors are needed, how many people the building must hold, and whether accessibility facilities are required. The URS is this owner's brief. The drawings the engineers later produce (DS), the installation outcome (IQ) and the test runs (OQ) must all be traced back to this brief to confirm compliance.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 填寫 URS 的常見痛點
blocks.en: In Practice - Common Pain Points When a CDMO Writes a URS

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，氣體系統通常服務多個客戶的多種產品。URS 中的「6.0 純度需求」與「4.0 顆粒/微生物限度」往往需要取最嚴格的客戶要求作為系統規格，否則未來接新客戶時必須重做 OQ/PQ。建議在 URS 審查時納入市場部與業務部門，提前預估未來5年可能引入的產品類型。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, a gas system usually serves several products for several clients. Section "6.0 Purity Requirements" and "4.0 Particle/Microbial Limits" of the URS often need to take the strictest client requirement as the system specification; otherwise OQ/PQ must be repeated whenever a new client is onboarded. It is advisable to involve marketing and business development in the URS review, so that the product types likely to be introduced over the next 5 years can be anticipated.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若某產品直接接觸氮氣（product-contact application），URS 中的哪3個項目最可能被歸類為 CQA？
blocks.en: If a product is in direct contact with nitrogen (a product-contact application), which 3 URS items are most likely to be classified as CQAs?

blocks.zh: 「冗餘設計（Redundancy）」屬於 URS 的哪個類型？如果冗餘失效導致斷氣，對 GMP 批次有何影響？
blocks.en: What type of URS item is "Redundancy"? If a redundancy failure causes a loss of gas supply, what is the impact on the GMP batch?

blocks.zh: Appendix 5 — The Effect of System Leakage 系統洩漏的影響
blocks.en: Appendix 5 - The Effect of System Leakage

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 為何洩漏是 GMP 問題而非僅是成本問題
blocks.en: Core Concept - Why Leakage Is a GMP Issue and Not Just a Cost Issue

blocks.zh: 在一般工業理解中，氣體洩漏主要是金錢損失。但在製藥環境中，洩漏有更嚴重的 GMP 含義：
blocks.en: In general industry, gas leakage is mainly understood as a financial loss. In a pharmaceutical environment, however, leakage has more serious GMP implications:

blocks.zh: 氮氣覆蓋系統（N₂ blanketing）：若氮氣管線有微小洩漏點，環境空氣（含 O₂、水分、微生物）可能在壓力波動時逆滲進入系統，破壞惰性保護
blocks.en: Nitrogen blanketing systems: if a nitrogen line has a tiny leak point, ambient air (containing O₂, moisture and microorganisms) can back-diffuse into the system during pressure fluctuations, destroying the inert protection

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣系統：洩漏點可能成為外部污染物進入點，尤其當系統停機時（正壓不足）
blocks.en: Compressed air systems: a leak point can become an entry point for external contaminants, especially when the system is shut down (insufficient positive pressure)

blocks.zh: 無菌充填用氣體：任何顆粒或微生物的侵入都可能導致批次廢棄
blocks.en: Gases used in aseptic filling: any ingress of particles or microorganisms can result in batch rejection

blocks.zh: 公式解讀 — Table 14.1 洩漏量的量級衝擊
blocks.en: Interpreting the Numbers - The Magnitude of Leakage in Table 14.1

blocks.zh:
在 100 psig 操作壓力下：

孔徑 1/16" = 6.5 SCFM
  → 約 184 L/min 的氣體損失
  → 全年損失：6.5 × 60 × 8760 ÷ 1000 = 3,416 千標準立方英尺

孔徑 1/4" = 104 SCFM
  → 幾乎是一台小型製程設備的全部需求量

關鍵洞察：
肉眼幾乎不可見的 1/16" 孔口
每分鐘已損失 6.5 立方英尺氣體
blocks.en:
At an operating pressure of 100 psig:

Orifice 1/16" = 6.5 SCFM
  → about 184 L/min of gas loss
  → annual loss: 6.5 × 60 × 8760 ÷ 1000 = 3,416 thousand standard cubic feet

Orifice 1/4" = 104 SCFM
  → almost the entire demand of a small piece of process equipment

Key insight:
A 1/16" orifice, barely visible to the naked eye,
already loses 6.5 cubic feet of gas per minute

blocks.zh: 這解釋了為何 ISPE 要求「壓力測試後施工」並建立持續的洩漏偵測計畫。
blocks.en: This explains why ISPE calls for pressure testing before construction proceeds and for an ongoing leak detection program.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — IQ 中的洩漏測試要求
blocks.en: Key Point - Leak Test Requirements in IQ

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試（Leak Test）是安裝資格（IQ）中的必要測試項目之一。常用方法：
blocks.en: The leak test is one of the required tests in installation qualification (IQ). Commonly used methods:

blocks.zh: 壓力衰減法（Pressure Decay）：封閉系統後觀察一定時間內的壓力降落，計算洩漏率
blocks.en: Pressure decay: seal the system and observe the pressure drop over a set time to calculate the leak rate

blocks.zh: 肥皂泡法（Bubble Test）：適用於接頭、閥門的局部洩漏點檢測
blocks.en: Bubble test: suitable for detecting localized leaks at joints and valves

blocks.zh: 氦氣示蹤法（Helium Tracer）：高靈敏度洩漏偵測，適用於超高純度氣體系統
blocks.en: Helium tracer: highly sensitive leak detection, suitable for ultra-high-purity gas systems

blocks.zh: IQ 協議中應明確列出可接受的洩漏率規格（如 <0.1% 每小時）。
blocks.en: The IQ protocol should clearly state the acceptable leak rate specification (for example, <0.1% per hour).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Pressure/Flow Controller 的角色
blocks.en: Analogy - The Role of the Pressure/Flow Controller

blocks.zh: 把壓縮機想像成城市供水塔，各廠區設備是用水戶。沒有壓力/流量控制器時，一台大型設備突然用水，整個廠區水壓都會下降。Pressure/Flow Controller 就像各棟大樓的恆壓閥：確保供應側（水塔）的壓力波動不傳遞到需求側（各用水點）。在製藥無菌充填中，壓力穩定性直接影響灌裝精度，這個隔離功能至關重要。
blocks.en: Think of the compressor as a city water tower and the equipment in each plant area as the water users. Without pressure/flow controllers, when one large piece of equipment suddenly draws water, the water pressure across the whole site drops. A pressure/flow controller works like a constant-pressure valve in each building: it ensures that pressure fluctuations on the supply side (the water tower) are not passed on to the demand side (the individual points of use). In pharmaceutical aseptic filling, pressure stability directly affects filling accuracy, so this isolation function is essential.

blocks.zh: 若氮氣覆蓋系統在生產期間因接頭洩漏導致 O₂ 含量從 <1 ppm 上升至 50 ppm，你會如何歸因這個偏差（deviation）？需要啟動哪些 CAPA？
blocks.en: If, during production, a joint leak causes the O₂ content in a nitrogen blanketing system to rise from <1 ppm to 50 ppm, how would you attribute this deviation? Which CAPAs would need to be initiated?

blocks.zh: Pressure/Flow Controller 的「back pressure flow device」功能在臨時斷氣時如何保護關鍵應用？請描述其工作原理。
blocks.en: How does the "back pressure flow device" function of the pressure/flow controller protect critical applications during a temporary loss of gas supply? Describe how it works.

blocks.zh: Appendix 6 — Nitrogen Gas Generation Systems 氮氣產生系統
blocks.en: Appendix 6 - Nitrogen Gas Generation Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 三種氮氣產生技術比較
blocks.en: Core Concept - Comparing the Three Nitrogen Generation Technologies

blocks.zh: 這三種技術在純度、成本、規模上有根本性差異，選型決策對製藥廠的長期運營影響極大：
blocks.en: The three technologies differ fundamentally in purity, cost and scale, and the selection decision has a major impact on the long-term operation of a pharmaceutical plant:

blocks.zh: 膜分離（Membrane）：最簡單，純度 95–99.5%，適合低純度需求（惰性保護、一般覆蓋）
blocks.en: Membrane: the simplest; purity 95-99.5%; suitable for low-purity needs (inert protection, general blanketing)

blocks.zh: PSA（Pressure Swing Adsorption）吸附法：純度 98–99.99%，中高用量現場產生的主流選擇
blocks.en: PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption): purity 98-99.99%; the mainstream choice for on-site generation at medium to high consumption

blocks.zh: 低溫液化（Cryogenic）：純度最高（1–100 ppm O₂），適合超高純度需求，資本成本極高
blocks.en: Cryogenic: the highest purity (1-100 ppm O₂); suitable for ultra-high-purity needs; very high capital cost

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — PSA 氮氣的關鍵限制（選型決策點）
blocks.en: Key Point - The Critical Limitation of PSA Nitrogen (a Selection Decision Point)

blocks.zh: 這是本附錄中最重要的工程決策點：
blocks.en: This is the most important engineering decision point in this appendix:

blocks.zh: PSA 典型最高純度 = 99.5% N₂ = 最低 0.5% O₂ = 5,000 ppm O₂
blocks.en: Typical maximum PSA purity = 99.5% N₂ = minimum 0.5% O₂ = 5,000 ppm O₂

blocks.zh: 如果應用需要 O₂ < 10 ppm（例如：高活性 API 的無氧包裝、鋰電池製造、某些生物製品的惰性覆蓋），PSA 系統根本無法達到規格。必須選擇液態氮（LIN）供應或低溫產生系統。
blocks.en: If the application requires O₂ < 10 ppm (for example, oxygen-free packaging of highly potent APIs, lithium battery manufacturing, or inert blanketing of certain biological products), a PSA system simply cannot meet the specification. Liquid nitrogen (LIN) supply or a cryogenic generation system must be chosen.

blocks.zh: 錯誤的技術選型在 URS 審查時最容易被忽略，卻在 OQ 測試時才發現，造成大量重工成本。
blocks.en: A wrong technology selection is the error most easily overlooked during URS review, yet it is only discovered during OQ testing, causing substantial rework costs.

blocks.zh: 選型比較矩陣
blocks.en: Selection Comparison Matrix

blocks.zh:
技術         純度上限        O₂ 殘留        適用場景
膜分離       99.5% N₂       0.5% O₂       一般惰性保護
PSA          99.99% N₂      100 ppm O₂    中高純度現場產氮
低溫液化     99.9999% N₂    1 ppm O₂      超高純度需求

經濟臨界點（PSA vs 液態 N₂）：
用量 > ~2,000 m³/月 → PSA 現場產生通常更經濟
用量 < ~500 m³/月  → 液態 N₂ 外購+儲槽通常更經濟
blocks.en:
Technology     Purity limit    O₂ residual    Suitable application
Membrane       99.5% N₂       0.5% O₂       General inert protection
PSA            99.99% N₂      100 ppm O₂    Medium-to-high-purity on-site nitrogen
Cryogenic      99.9999% N₂    1 ppm O₂      Ultra-high-purity needs

Economic break-even (PSA vs liquid N₂):
Consumption > ~2,000 m³/month → on-site PSA generation is usually more economical
Consumption < ~500 m³/month  → purchased liquid N₂ plus a storage tank is usually more economical

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — PSA 的雙塔輪替原理
blocks.en: Analogy - The Twin-Tower Alternation Principle of PSA

blocks.zh: PSA 的兩個吸附塔就像兩位接力跑步的選手：一位在跑步（生產氮氣、吸附氧氣），另一位在喘氣恢復（降壓再生、清除吸附的氧氣）。這個交替讓系統能連續輸出氮氣，不像單塔系統需要停機再生。分子篩就是跑步選手的體能——會疲勞（被 O₂ 佔滿），但能週期性恢復。
blocks.en: The two adsorption towers of a PSA unit are like two relay runners: one is running (producing nitrogen and adsorbing oxygen) while the other catches their breath (depressurizing and regenerating, purging the adsorbed oxygen). This alternation lets the system deliver nitrogen continuously, unlike a single-tower system that must stop for regeneration. The molecular sieve is the runner's stamina: it tires (becomes saturated with O₂) but recovers periodically.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 無菌充填線的氮氣選型
blocks.en: In Practice - Nitrogen Selection for a CDMO Aseptic Filling Line

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 CDMO 中，氮氣用途通常分為兩類：
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling CDMO, nitrogen uses generally fall into two categories:

blocks.zh: 產品直接接觸（product-contact）：瓶頭空間充氮、溶液覆蓋 → 通常需要藥典級純度，要求 O₂ <10–100 ppm → 必須用液態 N₂ 或低溫系統
blocks.en: Product-contact: headspace nitrogen flushing of vials and solution blanketing → usually requires pharmacopoeial-grade purity, with O₂ <10-100 ppm → liquid N₂ or a cryogenic system must be used

blocks.zh: 非直接接觸（non-product-contact）：設備覆蓋、安全惰化 → PSA 系統即可滿足
blocks.en: Non-product-contact: equipment blanketing and safety inerting → a PSA system is sufficient

blocks.zh: 因此許多 CDMO 同時設置 PSA 系統（供非直接接觸用）+ 液態 N₂ 儲槽（供直接接觸用），以平衡成本與純度需求。
blocks.en: Many CDMOs therefore install both a PSA system (for non-contact use) and a liquid N₂ storage tank (for contact use) to balance cost and purity requirements.

blocks.zh: 客戶要求充填後瓶頭空間 O₂ 含量 <1%（10,000 ppm），你會推薦 PSA 還是液態 N₂？請說明理由。
blocks.en: A client requires a post-fill headspace O₂ content of <1% (10,000 ppm). Would you recommend PSA or liquid N₂? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: PSA 系統的分子篩（CMS）老化後，氮氣純度會如何變化？你會在 OQ/PQ 中設計什麼監測項目來偵測這個退化？
blocks.en: How does nitrogen purity change as the carbon molecular sieve (CMS) of a PSA system ages? What monitoring items would you design into OQ/PQ to detect this degradation?

blocks.zh: Appendix 7 — Miscellaneous Information 雜項資訊
blocks.en: Appendix 7 - Miscellaneous Information

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 空氣組成對製藥氣體的意義
blocks.en: Core Concept - What the Composition of Air Means for Pharmaceutical Gases

blocks.zh: Table 16.1 告訴我們壓縮空氣的原料組成。對製藥而言，關鍵的污染物組分是：
blocks.en: Table 16.1 gives the composition of the feed air for compressed air. For pharmaceutical purposes, the key contaminant components are:

blocks.zh: O₂（20.99%）：PSA 氮氣系統要清除的主要對象；對易氧化藥品（脂質體、蛋白質）是降解風險
blocks.en: O₂ (20.99%): the main component that a PSA nitrogen system must remove; a degradation risk for oxidation-sensitive drugs (liposomes, proteins)

blocks.zh: CO₂（0.03%）：藥典要求壓縮空氣中 CO₂ <500 ppm；高 CO₂ 可能改變注射劑 pH
blocks.en: CO₂ (0.03%): the pharmacopoeias require CO₂ <500 ppm in compressed air; high CO₂ can change the pH of injectables

blocks.zh: Argon（0.933%）：化學惰性，通常不在控制指標中，但高純度氮氣中氬氣會被計入殘留量
blocks.en: Argon (0.933%): chemically inert and usually not a controlled parameter, but in high-purity nitrogen the argon is counted toward the residual content

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 露點（Dew Point）是壓縮空氣品質的關鍵指標
blocks.en: Key Point - Dew Point Is the Key Indicator of Compressed Air Quality

blocks.zh: Dew Point（露點）是壓縮空氣中水分含量的最重要指標。ISO 8573-1 以壓力露點（Pressure Dew Point, PDP）表示氣體乾燥程度：
blocks.en: Dew point is the most important indicator of the moisture content of compressed air. ISO 8573-1 expresses the dryness of the gas as the pressure dew point (PDP):

blocks.zh: ISO Class 1–2：PDP ≤ -70°C（超乾，用於敏感儀器氣體）
blocks.en: ISO Class 1-2: PDP ≤ -70°C (ultra-dry, used for sensitive instrument gases)

blocks.zh: ISO Class 4：PDP ≤ +3°C（一般製程用途）
blocks.en: ISO Class 4: PDP ≤ +3°C (general process use)

blocks.zh: ISO Class 6：PDP ≤ +10°C（非關鍵應用）
blocks.en: ISO Class 6: PDP ≤ +10°C (non-critical applications)

blocks.zh: Table 16.5 的絕對濕度資料直接連結到露點計算：溫度越高，空氣可攜帶的水分越多，冷凝風險越大。
blocks.en: The absolute humidity data in Table 16.5 link directly to dew point calculation: the higher the temperature, the more moisture the air can carry, and the greater the condensation risk.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 水活性（a<sub>W</sub>）與微生物控制
blocks.en: Core Concept - Water Activity (a<sub>W</sub>) and Microbial Control

blocks.zh: 水活性（Water Activity, aW）是食品科學概念，但同樣適用於製藥氣體系統的微生物風險評估。aW 代表基質中自由水的比例（0=完全乾燥，1=純水）。
blocks.en: Water activity (aW) is a food science concept, but it applies equally to the microbial risk assessment of pharmaceutical gas systems. aW represents the proportion of free water in a medium (0 = completely dry, 1 = pure water).

blocks.zh: Table 16.6 的關鍵洞察：當 a<sub>W</sub> < 0.50 時，所有微生物均無法增殖。這解釋了為何乾燥的壓縮空氣（露點 <-20°C，對應的水分活性遠低於 0.5）本身不是微生物生長的良好環境——但管線中的冷凝水積聚點是高風險區域。
blocks.en: Key insight from Table 16.6: when a<sub>W</sub> < 0.50, no microorganisms can proliferate. This explains why dry compressed air (dew point <-20°C, with a corresponding water activity well below 0.5) is not in itself a good environment for microbial growth, but points in the piping where condensate accumulates are high-risk areas.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 露點就像浴室鏡子起霧
blocks.en: Analogy - Dew Point Is Like a Fogged Bathroom Mirror

blocks.zh: 洗熱水澡後，浴室鏡子起霧（凝結），因為空氣中的水分超過了鏡面溫度對應的飽和量。壓縮空氣管線中也一樣：若管線某段溫度低於氣體的露點，水分就會凝結在管壁上，形成積水——這既是管線腐蝕的根源，也是微生物的「綠洲」。乾燥器的任務就是讓露點遠低於管線可能達到的最低溫度。
blocks.en: After a hot shower, the bathroom mirror fogs up (condenses) because the moisture in the air exceeds the saturation level corresponding to the mirror's temperature. The same happens in a compressed air line: if any section of the line is colder than the dew point of the gas, moisture condenses on the pipe wall and forms standing water. This is both a source of pipe corrosion and an "oasis" for microorganisms. The dryer's job is to keep the dew point well below the lowest temperature the piping may reach.

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣進入廠房分配管線前，露點規格應如何設定？需要考慮哪些環境因素？
blocks.en: How should the dew point specification be set before compressed air enters the plant distribution lines? Which environmental factors need to be considered?

blocks.zh: Table 16.6 顯示大腸桿菌的抑制 a<sub>W</sub> 是 0.95。這對濕式壓縮空氣過濾器的設計有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Table 16.6 shows that the inhibiting a<sub>W</sub> for E. coli is 0.95. What does this imply for the design of wet compressed air filters?

blocks.zh: Appendix 8 — References 參考文獻
blocks.en: Appendix 8 - References

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 氣體系統品質的標準體系
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Hierarchy of Standards for Gas System Quality

blocks.zh: 製藥氣體系統的品質規格由多層標準體系共同定義，理解各層的優先順序至關重要：
blocks.en: The quality specifications of pharmaceutical gas systems are jointly defined by a multi-tier system of standards, and it is essential to understand the order of precedence of each tier:

blocks.zh: 第一層：法規要求 — 21 CFR 210/211（美國）、EU Annex 1（歐洲）、ICH Q7/Q9 — 不可低於
blocks.en: Tier 1: Regulatory requirements - 21 CFR 210/211 (US), EU Annex 1 (Europe), ICH Q7/Q9 - must not be undercut

blocks.zh: 第二層：藥典規格 — USP、PhEur、JP 氣體專論 — 直接引用在 CoA 和批記錄
blocks.en: Tier 2: Pharmacopoeial specifications - USP, PhEur, JP gas monographs - cited directly in CoAs and batch records

blocks.zh: 第三層：工業標準 — ISO 8573-1（壓縮空氣純度等級）、ANSI/ISA（儀器空氣）— 設計依據
blocks.en: Tier 3: Industry standards - ISO 8573-1 (compressed air purity classes), ANSI/ISA (instrument air) - the design basis

blocks.zh: 第四層：指引文件 — ISPE、PDA、CGA — 最佳實踐，不具法律強制力
blocks.en: Tier 4: Guidance documents - ISPE, PDA, CGA - best practice, not legally binding

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — ISO 8573-1:2010 是關鍵設計標準
blocks.en: Key Point - ISO 8573-1:2010 Is the Key Design Standard

blocks.zh: ISO 8573-1:2010（壓縮空氣純度等級）是設計壓縮空氣系統品質規格的核心參考標準，以三個指標分類：
blocks.en: ISO 8573-1:2010 (compressed air purity classes) is the core reference standard for setting the quality specification of a compressed air system, and classifies air by three parameters:

blocks.zh: 顆粒等級（Particle Class）：Class 1 = 最嚴格（≥0.1 µm <20,000/m³）
blocks.en: Particle class: Class 1 = most stringent (≥0.1 µm <20,000/m³)

blocks.zh: 水分等級（Humidity/Water Class）：以壓力露點（PDP）定義，Class 1 = PDP ≤ -70°C
blocks.en: Humidity/water class: defined by pressure dew point (PDP); Class 1 = PDP ≤ -70°C

blocks.zh: 油脂等級（Oil Class）：Class 1 = 油含量 ≤ 0.01 mg/m³
blocks.en: Oil class: Class 1 = oil content ≤ 0.01 mg/m³

blocks.zh: 藥典中的醫用空氣（Medical Air）要求通常對應 ISO 8573-1 Class 1–2。在 URS 中引用 ISO 8573-1 等級是定義純度規格的標準做法。
blocks.en: Pharmacopoeial requirements for medical air generally correspond to ISO 8573-1 Class 1-2. Citing ISO 8573-1 classes in the URS is the standard way to define the purity specification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 藥典氣體專論的角色
blocks.en: Analogy - The Role of Pharmacopoeial Gas Monographs

blocks.zh: 藥典氣體專論（如 USP <Medical Air>、PhEur <Nitrogen>）就像食品標準的「國家標準成分表」：它定義了每種氣體「達到藥用等級」的最低要求。製藥廠在 CoA 中引用這些專論，監管機構據此判斷氣體是否符合用於製造藥品的資格。超出藥典規格的自主限度（internal specification）可以更嚴格，但不能更寬鬆。
blocks.en: Pharmacopoeial gas monographs (such as USP <Medical Air> and PhEur <Nitrogen>) are like the "national standard ingredient list" of food standards: they define the minimum requirements for each gas to qualify as pharmaceutical grade. Pharmaceutical companies cite these monographs in their CoAs, and regulators use them to judge whether a gas qualifies for use in manufacturing medicinal products. An internal specification that goes beyond the pharmacopoeial specification may be tighter, but never looser.

blocks.zh: 在審查供應商的氮氣 CoA 時，你會核對哪個藥典的哪個專論？若供應商報告與藥典規格不同，你會如何處理？
blocks.en: When reviewing a supplier's nitrogen CoA, which monograph of which pharmacopoeia would you check against? If the supplier's report differs from the pharmacopoeial specification, how would you handle it?

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500-07 在氣體系統的 DQ 審查中扮演什麼角色？它與 ISPE Baseline Vol. 5 的關係是什麼？
blocks.en: What role does ASTM E2500-07 play in the DQ review of a gas system? How does it relate to ISPE Baseline Vol. 5?

blocks.zh: Appendix 9 — Glossary 術語表
blocks.en: Appendix 9 - Glossary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 術語表的實際用途
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Practical Use of the Glossary

blocks.zh: 本術語表不只是字典。在氣體系統資格確認計畫中，它有三個實際功能：
blocks.en: This glossary is more than a dictionary. In a gas system qualification program it serves three practical functions:

blocks.zh: 一致性保證：確保 URS、DS、IQ、OQ、PQ 全套文件使用相同術語定義，避免稽查時被質疑
blocks.en: Consistency assurance: ensures that the whole document set (URS, DS, IQ, OQ, PQ) uses the same term definitions, avoiding challenges during inspections

blocks.zh: 跨部門溝通：工程、QA、生產的人員對 CPP、CQA、PDP 有共同的理解基礎
blocks.en: Cross-functional communication: engineering, QA and production staff share a common understanding of CPP, CQA and PDP

blocks.zh: 監管對齊：所有定義都來自 ICH Q8/Q9、ASTM E2500 等官方文件，直接引用出處
blocks.en: Regulatory alignment: all definitions come from official documents such as ICH Q8/Q9 and ASTM E2500, with the source cited directly

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 氣體系統資格確認必知的10個關鍵術語
blocks.en: Key Point - 10 Key Terms Essential for Gas System Qualification

blocks.zh: PDP（Pressure Dewpoint）：壓力露點 — 壓縮空氣乾燥品質的主要量測指標
blocks.en: PDP (Pressure Dewpoint): the main measurement of compressed air dryness

blocks.zh: POU（Point of Use）：使用點 — 取樣和驗收規格應在 POU 驗證，而非供應端
blocks.en: POU (Point of Use): sampling and acceptance specifications should be verified at the POU, not at the supply end

blocks.zh: Blanketing（覆蓋）：氮氣保護的技術術語，區別於「purging（吹掃）」
blocks.en: Blanketing: the technical term for nitrogen protection, distinct from "purging"

blocks.zh: TVHC（Total Volatile Hydrocarbon）：壓縮空氣中油脂污染的量測項目
blocks.en: TVHC (Total Volatile Hydrocarbon): the measurement for oil contamination in compressed air

blocks.zh: ETOP/TOP（交接包）：系統完工後移交 QA 用的全套文件集
blocks.en: ETOP/TOP (Engineering Turnover Package): the full document set handed over to QA after system completion

blocks.zh: FAT（工廠驗收測試）：在供應商處完成的預安裝資格確認測試
blocks.en: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test): pre-installation qualification testing completed at the supplier's site

blocks.zh: LEL（爆炸下限）：可燃氣體（O₂、H₂）安全設計的關鍵參數
blocks.en: LEL (Lower Explosive Limit): a key parameter in the safety design for flammable gases (O₂, H₂)

blocks.zh: PRV（壓力調節閥）：系統中的壓力控制元件，需在 IQ 中確認設定值
blocks.en: PRV (Pressure Regulating Valve): a pressure control element in the system whose set point must be confirmed in IQ

blocks.zh: CQA/CPP：決定哪些氣體參數需要 PQ 驗證的分類依據
blocks.en: CQA/CPP: the basis for classifying which gas parameters require PQ verification

blocks.zh: GEP（良好工程實踐）：低風險設施/設備的設計基準，不需要完整資格確認
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practice): the design basis for low-risk facilities/equipment that do not require full qualification

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — System Owner 與 Process Owner 的分工
blocks.en: Analogy - Division of Roles Between System Owner and Process Owner

blocks.zh: System Owner（系統擁有者）就像大樓的管理處主任，負責確保電梯、空調、消防系統正常運行、符合法規。Process Owner（製程擁有者）就像大樓的租戶，負責在這個空間內的生產活動。當氣體系統發生問題時，System Owner 處理基礎設施合規；Process Owner 處理對批次的影響評估——兩者的 CAPA 責任劃分應在 SOP 中明確定義。
blocks.en: The System Owner is like the building's facilities manager, responsible for ensuring that the elevators, air conditioning and fire protection systems operate properly and comply with regulations. The Process Owner is like a tenant of the building, responsible for the production activities carried out within that space. When a problem occurs in the gas system, the System Owner handles infrastructure compliance, while the Process Owner handles the batch impact assessment; the division of CAPA responsibilities between the two should be clearly defined in an SOP.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Blanketing vs. Purging vs. Pressurizing
blocks.en: Core Concept - Blanketing vs. Purging vs. Pressurizing

blocks.zh: 這三個氮氣使用模式容易混淆，但目的和操作參數不同：
blocks.en: These three nitrogen usage modes are easily confused, but their purposes and operating parameters differ:

blocks.zh: Blanketing（覆蓋）：在液面或產品上方維持惰性氣層，防止 O₂/水分接觸。通常是靜態或低流量持續補充模式
blocks.en: Blanketing: maintaining an inert gas layer above a liquid surface or product to prevent contact with O₂/moisture. Usually a static or low-flow continuous make-up mode

blocks.zh: Purging（吹掃）：主動用氮氣流驅替容器或管線中的空氣，在使用前或清潔後進行。需要較大流量
blocks.en: Purging: actively displacing the air in a vessel or line with a nitrogen flow, performed before use or after cleaning. Requires a higher flow rate

blocks.zh: Pressurizing（加壓）：利用氮氣建立正壓，防止外部氣體進入（如密封反應器）或推動液體傳輸
blocks.en: Pressurizing: using nitrogen to establish positive pressure to prevent ingress of external gas (for example, a sealed reactor) or to drive liquid transfer

blocks.zh: URS 中需要明確區分應用模式，因為它們對應不同的純度規格和流量計算。
blocks.en: The URS must clearly distinguish between application modes, because they correspond to different purity specifications and flow calculations.

blocks.zh: 單位換算快查 — 製藥氣體常用換算
blocks.en: Quick Unit Conversion Reference - Common Conversions for Pharmaceutical Gases

blocks.zh:
體積流量：
1 SCFM = 28.32 L/min = 1.699 m³/hr

壓力：
1 psig = 0.0689 bar(g) = 6.895 kPa(g)
1 bar = 14.504 psig

露點換算（近似）：
PDP -70°C ≈ 水分含量 ~2.5 ppm(v)
PDP -40°C ≈ 水分含量 ~128 ppm(v)
PDP  -20°C ≈ 水分含量 ~935 ppm(v)
PDP   +3°C ≈ ISO 8573-1 Class 4 水分等級

供應流量換算：
CFM → m³/hr：÷ 0.589
m³/hr → CFM：× 0.589
blocks.en:
Volumetric flow:
1 SCFM = 28.32 L/min = 1.699 m³/hr

Pressure:
1 psig = 0.0689 bar(g) = 6.895 kPa(g)
1 bar = 14.504 psig

Dew point conversion (approximate):
PDP -70°C ≈ moisture content ~2.5 ppm(v)
PDP -40°C ≈ moisture content ~128 ppm(v)
PDP  -20°C ≈ moisture content ~935 ppm(v)
PDP   +3°C ≈ ISO 8573-1 Class 4 humidity class

Supply flow conversion:
CFM → m³/hr: ÷ 0.589
m³/hr → CFM: × 0.589

blocks.zh: ETOP（Engineering Turnover Package）在氣體系統的哪個生命週期節點移交？它應包含哪些最關鍵的文件類型？
blocks.en: At which lifecycle milestone of a gas system is the ETOP (Engineering Turnover Package) handed over? Which document types should it include as the most critical?

blocks.zh: 「Process Gases are defined as gases which can affect product quality」— 根據這個定義，廠房暖通空調（HVAC）用的壓縮空氣算不算 Process Gas？請闡述你的邏輯。
blocks.en: "Process Gases are defined as gases which can affect product quality" - according to this definition, does the compressed air used for plant HVAC count as a Process Gas? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Section Summary — Appendices 4–9
blocks.en: Section Summary - Appendices 4-9

blocks.zh: 附錄4 URS：氣體系統的15個使用者需求項目中，純度、水分、顆粒、微生物限度、壓力、流量（項目1–6）是 CQA/CPP 等級，直接決定 IQ/OQ/PQ 的測試深度
blocks.en: Appendix 4 URS: of the 15 user requirement items for a gas system, purity, moisture, particles, microbial limits, pressure and flow (items 1-6) are at CQA/CPP level and directly determine the depth of IQ/OQ/PQ testing

blocks.zh: 附錄5 洩漏：即使 1/16 英寸的微小孔口在 100 psig 下每分鐘洩漏超過 6 SCFM；洩漏不只是成本問題，在氮氣覆蓋系統中可能導致環境空氣逆滲，破壞產品品質
blocks.en: Appendix 5 Leakage: even a 1/16-inch orifice leaks more than 6 SCFM per minute at 100 psig; leakage is not only a cost issue, and in a nitrogen blanketing system it can cause back-diffusion of ambient air and compromise product quality

blocks.zh: 附錄6 氮氣產生：PSA 系統最高純度約 99.99%（最低 100 ppm O₂），但標準 PSA 通常僅達 99.5%（5,000 ppm O₂）；需要 <10 ppm O₂ 的應用必須選擇液態氮或低溫系統
blocks.en: Appendix 6 Nitrogen generation: the maximum PSA purity is about 99.99% (minimum 100 ppm O₂), but standard PSA typically reaches only 99.5% (5,000 ppm O₂); applications requiring <10 ppm O₂ must use liquid nitrogen or a cryogenic system

blocks.zh: 附錄7 雜項：露點（PDP）是壓縮空氣水分品質的核心指標；水活性（aW）<0.5 可抑制所有微生物增殖，乾燥氣體本身不支持微生物生長，但管線冷凝積水點是風險區
blocks.en: Appendix 7 Miscellaneous: dew point (PDP) is the core indicator of compressed air moisture quality; water activity (aW) <0.5 inhibits the proliferation of all microorganisms, so dry gas does not itself support microbial growth, but points of condensate accumulation in the piping are risk areas

blocks.zh: 附錄8 參考文獻：ISO 8573-1:2010 是壓縮空氣設計的核心標準；藥典氣體專論（USP/PhEur/JP）是 CoA 驗收的法定依據；ICH Q9 定義風險管理框架
blocks.en: Appendix 8 References: ISO 8573-1:2010 is the core standard for compressed air design; pharmacopoeial gas monographs (USP/PhEur/JP) are the legal basis for CoA acceptance; ICH Q9 defines the risk management framework

blocks.zh: 附錄9 術語表：PDP、POU、TVHC、ETOP、Blanketing 是氣體系統資格確認文件中最常見的專業術語；所有定義應追溯至 ICH Q8/Q9 或 ASTM E2500-07 等官方出處
blocks.en: Appendix 9 Glossary: PDP, POU, TVHC, ETOP and Blanketing are the most common technical terms in gas system qualification documents; all definitions should be traceable to official sources such as ICH Q8/Q9 or ASTM E2500-07
